```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite:** U31_10 - Lab Management System

**Target System:** Lab Management System

**Test Objective:** Verify the functionality of lab requests, patient invoices, and patient profile archiving.

**Test Scope:**

* Functional testing of lab request management, patient invoice generation, and patient profile archiving.
* Offline functionality for actual sample collection, lab tests, and report submission to patients.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Requirement ID(s) | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | View Open Lab Requests | Req-10 | Positive | User is logged in as Lab In-charge | None | Open lab requests are displayed on the screen. | Lab requests are displayed correctly. |
| TC-002 | Update Lab Request Status | Req-10 | Positive | User is logged in as Lab In-charge | Status update form is filled | Status of the selected lab request is updated. | Status is updated successfully. |
| TC-003 | Print Prescription | Req-11 | Positive | User is logged in as Patient | None | Prescription is printed. | Prescription is printed correctly. |
| TC-004 | Print Invoice | Req-11 | Positive | User is logged in as Patient | None | Invoice is printed. | Invoice is printed correctly. |
| TC-005 | Print Prescription (Admin) | Req-11 | Positive | User is logged in as Admin | Patient ID is entered | Prescription is printed for the selected patient. | Prescription is printed correctly. |
| TC-006 | Email Invoice (Admin) | Req-11 | Positive | User is logged in as Admin | Patient ID is entered | Invoice is emailed to the selected patient. | Invoice is emailed successfully. |
| TC-007 | Archive Inactive Patient Profiles | Req-12 | Positive | User is logged in as Admin | Quarterly report is generated | Inactive patient profiles are archived. | Inactive patient profiles are archived successfully. |
| TC-008 | Archive Old Consultation Requests | Req-12 | Positive | User is logged in as Admin | Quarterly report is generated | Consultation requests older than 3 years are archived. | Consultation requests are archived successfully. |

```
